title: Guitar TAB CSV
documented_semantics: Field meanings based on 2026-11-19 developer dictionary, with RC1 panning fields verified by current integration tests. Runtime validator determines actual acceptance.

columns.name: staff
columns.description: Names the notation staff for this event.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text, e.g. Upper staff or Lower staff
columns.blank_means: Not valid for a sounding Pitched event.

columns.name: measure
columns.description: One-based bar number in the composition.
columns.blank_means: Required for every event.

columns.name: count_aloud
columns.description: Human-friendly counted onset inside the bar.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Meter-specific count, e.g. One, Two and
columns.blank_means: Required on Pitched note rows.

columns.name: running_time
columns.description: Display of the event onset on the whole-piece clock.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: m minutes and two-digit seconds; e.g. 0m 02s
columns.blank_means: Regenerate; do not invent it independently.

columns.name: duration_beats
columns.description: Sounding note length measured in quarter-note beats.
columns.blank_means: Required for a sounding note.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.description: Calculated duration of the event in milliseconds.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from authoritative timing.

columns.name: velocity
columns.description: MIDI note-on attack strength, not mixer volume.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Integer 1–127; 64 is a common starting choice
columns.blank_means: Required for a sounding note.

columns.name: tempo_bpm
columns.description: Composition tempo expressed as quarter notes per minute.
columns.blank_means: Required; must agree across imported parts.

columns.name: time_signature
columns.description: Meter used to interpret bars and counts.
columns.blank_means: Required; must agree across imported parts.

columns.name: key_signature
columns.description: Notated tonal key, distinct from the actual MIDI pitches.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text, e.g. C major, Bb major
columns.blank_means: Do not infer or silently change a composer-selected key.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: Human-readable musical part or instrument name.
columns.blank_means: Historical default Piano; Studio routing is track-specific.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: TAB chord, strum or rest classification driving which string data apply.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: tab_chord and rest observed in historical examples; validate other events with current Rust core.
columns.blank_means: Event type must be explicit.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Stable, unique identifier used to review edits and receipts.
columns.blank_means: Do not silently regenerate IDs of surviving notes.

columns.name: onset_beat_in_measure
columns.description: Numerical beat offset expressed with 1 at the barline.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Decimal, 1 + elapsed quarter-note beats in the bar
columns.blank_means: Derived from count and meter.

columns.name: onset_ms
columns.description: Event attack position from the start of the composition.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from tempo and tick position.

columns.name: end_ms
columns.description: Event release position from composition start.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from onset and sounding duration.

columns.name: velocity_description
columns.description: Readable dynamic description of the note velocity.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text such as p, mf or Medium
columns.blank_means: Display-level derived value; do not use instead of velocity.

columns.name: clef
columns.description: Clef to present on the staff.
columns.blank_means: May be derived from the staff mapping.

columns.name: clef_sign
columns.description: Notation clef sign associated with the clef.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Typically G or F for pitched staves
columns.blank_means: Derived from clef if omitted.

columns.name: clef_line
columns.description: Staff line where the clef sign is anchored.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Integer; typical G clef = 2, F clef = 4
columns.blank_means: Derived from clef when possible.

columns.name: voice
columns.description: Voice number for notation within the staff.
columns.blank_means: Exporter or reader may infer a notation voice.

columns.name: notated_type
columns.description: Engraved duration category, independently of sounding duration.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: whole, half, quarter, eighth, 16th in historical guide
columns.blank_means: Reader may choose notated appearance; no assertion.

columns.name: notated_duration_beats
columns.description: Optional written note value in quarter-note beats.
columns.blank_means: Follow sounding duration when not separately specified.

columns.name: notated_dots
columns.description: Augmentation-dot count for written notation.
columns.blank_means: Notation may infer dotting.

columns.name: tie_start
columns.description: Notation flag indicating the beginning of a tie.
columns.blank_means: No start of tie explicitly asserted.

columns.name: tie_stop
columns.description: Notation flag indicating the end of a tie.
columns.blank_means: No end of tie explicitly asserted.

columns.name: articulation
columns.description: Written/performance articulation of the event.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text such as staccato, accent, tenuto, marcato
columns.blank_means: No articulation specified.

columns.name: beam
columns.description: Explicit beaming role in notated rhythm.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: begin, continue or end in original manual
columns.blank_means: Notation may infer beaming.

columns.name: midi_file_format
columns.description: Standard MIDI File structural format policy.
columns.blank_means: Must use consistent export policy.

columns.name: ticks_per_quarter
columns.description: MIDI timeline resolution: ticks per quarter note.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Positive integer; current fixtures commonly use 480
columns.blank_means: Do not assume a hard-coded value; read the file.

columns.name: midi_track
columns.description: Track number used in MIDI export and mappings.
columns.blank_means: May be mapped from Studio track/staff.

columns.name: midi_track_name
columns.description: Readable name of the target MIDI track.
columns.blank_means: Can be derived from part/staff if absent.

columns.name: midi_channel
columns.description: MIDI channel assigned to this part.
columns.blank_means: Requires track/part mapping if absent.

columns.name: midi_program
columns.description: Zero-based General MIDI program number.
columns.blank_means: Mapped or chosen by instrument profile.

columns.name: program_change_emit
columns.description: Whether a MIDI program-change event should be emitted.
columns.blank_means: Historical default No; do not emit changes unasked.

columns.name: program_source
columns.description: Provenance of the MIDI program selection.
columns.blank_means: No source assertion.

columns.name: midi_bank_msb
columns.description: Optional MIDI bank-select most-significant byte, CC0.
columns.blank_means: No bank event requested.

columns.name: midi_bank_lsb
columns.description: Optional MIDI bank-select least-significant byte, CC32.
columns.blank_means: No bank event requested.

columns.name: note_off_method
columns.description: Policy for serializing note release events.
columns.blank_means: Historical default note_on_velocity_zero.

columns.name: note_off_velocity
columns.description: Release velocity when a note-off is sent.
columns.blank_means: Historical default 0.

columns.name: absolute_tick
columns.description: Onset tick counted from the composition start.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from measure and local onset.

columns.name: onset_tick_in_measure
columns.description: Tick offset after the start of the bar.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from local onset.

columns.name: duration_ticks
columns.description: Sounding duration in MIDI ticks.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from beats and tick resolution.

columns.name: end_tick
columns.description: Absolute release tick of the note.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Nonnegative integer; onset tick + duration ticks
columns.blank_means: Recompute from event timing.

columns.name: tempo_us_per_quarter
columns.description: MIDI tempo as microseconds for one quarter note.
columns.blank_means: Recompute from tempo_bpm.

columns.name: tempo_beat_unit
columns.description: Unit against which the BPM count is expressed.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: quarter in the original six-meter baseline
columns.blank_means: Historical policy is quarter.

columns.name: pitch_octave_convention
columns.description: Defines the pitch/octave naming system.
columns.blank_means: Policy must remain consistent.

columns.name: tick_rounding_policy
columns.description: States how fractional tick results are rounded/handled.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text policy; respect actual imported policy
columns.blank_means: Do not silently invent new rounding.

columns.name: same_tick_event_order
columns.description: Ordering policy for simultaneous note releases and attacks.
columns.blank_means: Protect deterministic retrigger ordering.

columns.name: time_signature_num
columns.description: Numerator derived from the time signature.
columns.blank_means: Computed from time_signature.

columns.name: time_signature_den
columns.description: Denominator derived from the time signature.
columns.blank_means: Computed from time_signature.

columns.name: key_signature_fifths
columns.description: Circle-of-fifths encoding of key signature.
columns.blank_means: Derived from key_signature.

columns.name: key_signature_mode
columns.description: Major/minor designation for MIDI key signature.
columns.blank_means: Derived from key_signature.

columns.name: controller_number
columns.description: Generic MIDI Continuous Controller number.
columns.blank_means: No generic controller event.

columns.name: controller_value
columns.description: Value for the generic MIDI controller above.
columns.blank_means: No generic controller event; verify paired fields.

columns.name: cc1_modulation
columns.description: MIDI CC1 modulation amount.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc2_breath
columns.description: MIDI CC2 breath controller amount.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc7_channel_volume
columns.description: MIDI CC7 channel volume; different from note velocity.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc10_pan
columns.description: MIDI CC10 pan position.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc11_expression
columns.description: MIDI CC11 musical expression amount.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc64_sustain
columns.description: MIDI CC64 sustain-pedal state.
columns.blank_means: Blank means no event, not pedal release.

columns.name: cc91_reverb_send
columns.description: MIDI CC91 reverb send, not Studio’s necessarily separate audio effect settings.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: cc93_chorus_send
columns.description: MIDI CC93 chorus send, not Studio’s necessarily separate audio effect settings.
columns.blank_means: Do not emit controller event.

columns.name: pitch_bend
columns.description: Raw MIDI pitch bend position for this event.
columns.blank_means: No pitch-bend message requested.

columns.name: channel_aftertouch
columns.description: Channel-wide pressure aftertouch amount.
columns.blank_means: No channel-pressure event.

columns.name: poly_aftertouch
columns.description: Per-note pressure aftertouch amount.
columns.blank_means: No per-note aftertouch event.

columns.name: sysex_payload
columns.description: MIDI System Exclusive content if implemented by an exporter.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text payload; codec/encoding must be specified separately
columns.blank_means: No SysEx message.

columns.name: controller_event_policy
columns.description: Describes whether an empty controller column emits an event.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Text policy; reference: blank = emit no event
columns.blank_means: Do not assume unspecified controller events.

columns.name: composition_title
columns.description: Title establishing the identity of the shared composition.
columns.blank_means: Required to establish/import a composition.

columns.name: composer
columns.description: Human-approved composer credit.
columns.blank_means: Never fabricate a composer credit.

columns.name: composition_total_measures
columns.description: Declared total number of full measures in the composition.
columns.blank_means: Required for synchronized composition identity.

columns.name: composition_end_tick
columns.description: Closing full-measure barline shared with all parts; not the tick of the last guitar chord.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Integer computed from meter × ticks-per-quarter × total measures
columns.blank_means: Recompute/verify; do not end early at last note.

columns.name: composition_duration
columns.description: Readable whole-piece length for display.
columns.blank_means: Derived from full-measure composition length.

columns.name: lyric
columns.description: Lyric syllable attached to the musical event.
columns.blank_means: No lyric attached.

columns.name: marker
columns.description: Section marker or structural cue at an onset.
columns.blank_means: No marker attached.

columns.name: source_note_data
columns.description: Explains the provenance of note content.
columns.blank_means: No note-source claim recorded.

columns.name: source_clef
columns.description: Explains where the chosen clef came from.
columns.blank_means: No clef-source claim.

columns.name: source_key_signature
columns.description: Explains evidence for the selected key signature.
columns.blank_means: No key-source claim.

columns.name: source_instrument
columns.description: Explains the observed or authored instrument/program choice.
columns.blank_means: No instrument-source claim.

columns.name: source_license
columns.description: Describes the rights/licence of source musical material.
columns.blank_means: No licence claim. Do not assume public domain.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: A source reference for provenance and attribution.
columns.blank_means: No source URL claimed.

columns.name: String_1_Pan_Position
columns.description: Places the named guitar string’s sounding event in the stereo field independently of the other strings in the same row.
columns.accepted_values_and_units: Whole integer −100 (hard left) through 0 (centre) to +100 (hard right); fractional positions and values outside the range are rejected by RC1 pan validation.
columns.blank_means: No authored pan override; preserve the loaded SoundFont’s native stereo placement. A blank is NOT the same as 0.
columns.example: −100 for a left-panned string, 100 for a right-panned string, or blank
